fact: taskbook_query_facts treats an exact registered query as a label. An explicit label restricts text lookup to matching rows.
Text lookup matches normalized query terms against fact text and paths.
Each query result includes the matching fact’s path, row ID, text, source, and labels.
Text search ranks term coverage and phrase matches first; ties favor sourced facts and shorter text.
Fact queries return up to five distinct fact texts by default. The limit can be set from one to ten.
A project fact reference identifies its subject TSV path and row ID, joined by #.
